d: Paula Poundstone takes on the media in a hour of stand-up live from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Come see Poundstone as she's joined by Daniel Crow, Joe Pontillo, Jermaine Warren and Greg Stone.

Vic Dibitetto takes the stage for an hour of non-stop comedy live from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss Dibitetto along with Forrest Shaw, Jeff Young, Jessica Kirson and Shuli from "The Howard Stern Show."

Michael Che will have you gasping for air as he hosts an outrageous hour of comedy live from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss the "Weekend Update" anchor along with up-and-coming comics Ed Hill, Kelly MacFarland and Mark Poolos.

Judah Friedlander hosts a hilarious hour of stand-up at New York's legendary Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss Judah, Andy Hendrickson, Ruperto Vanderpool, Jena Friedman and Fahim Anwar for a night of over-the-top comedy.

Don't miss this episode starring the unpredictable and outrageous "Saturday Night Live" alum Jim Breuer live from New York's Gotham Comedy Club. Also featuring Jessica Kirson, Jeff Dye, Rich Aronovitch and Isiah Kelly.

Get ready for a night of big laughs with Ralphie May ("Last Comic Standing"). Don't miss this veteran comic along with Lahna Turner, Matt Burke, Leonard Ouzts and Vladimir Caamano for an hour of stand-up live from New York's Gotham Comedy Club.

Bill Engvall takes the stage for an outrageous hour of stand-up comedy live from New York's legendary Gotham Comedy Club. Don't miss Engvall along with four of America's funniest comics: Jason Lawhead, Brad Zimmerman, Jen Murphy and Beth Stelling.
